theme: A wide-open day with a departure on the horizon.
greeting: No meetings on the calendar today, Dan — a rare open stretch. But Croatia is three days out and one decision has a clock on it, so the quiet is the calendar's, not the to-do list's.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Your board set today as the call, and it is a real fork: the Oct 18-Nov 1 St. Pete rental and car both already cover Halloween, so choosing Maine unwinds bookings and puts a deadline on the Portland house. You are offline on the boat Sept 8-20, so it cannot wait for the trip to be over.

needsAttention.title: Close the last Croatia bookings
needsAttention.detail: You fly Tuesday and lose signal on the charter, so anything left has to be booked from dry land now. Still open and marked P1: the Sept 19 Cavtat night plus the noon Komolac transfer, and the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap before the girls' Tuesday pickup.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags, and two 55L duffels will not fly as carry-on on Eurowings Discover. Pull it up on the operating carrier's site and buy the bags online if needed — far cheaper than the airport counter.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Nautilus boarding details
needsAttention.detail: Reach the instructor to confirm the Sept 12 boarding time and place and to arrange the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport — the packet asks you to sort the transfer early, before bandwidth drops underway.

flagged.title: Valoris wants to set the Nomura call
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris wrote Friday that you two still need to talk and floated a real project for Nomura, though he doubts Chie has the budget — the call is yours to schedule.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, a Dex keep-in-touch digest, and the St. Pete Airbnb host — nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: The UN PRI call with Conor's office is parked until you're back; Kate confirmed no rush.

resolved.title: UN PRI call deferred to post-trip
resolved.detail: You asked Conor Kehoe's office to reschedule the sustainability and stewardship call after your trip; Kate confirmed no rush and to reconnect when you're back.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and hearty greens worth building a warm salad around.

tasks.title: Book the refundable backup car, Sept 20-Oct 5 (TPA)
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar today — the only thing wearing a clock is the Halloween decision, due before Croatia takes it out of your hands.
Croatia is three days out; the last open P1 bookings all have to close from dry land before Tuesday's flight.
The girls are in residence with you and Mike in St. Pete, and Mike's Sunday review opens the day at nine tomorrow.
